catalog_rules: If a category title joins several things (for example "Rugs and Decor", which also holds sculptures and accent tables), do not search it. Use its child category whose title is just the product type (for example "Rugs", slug rugs-and-decor-rugs), and never list sculptures, tables or other items as rugs. If list_categories shows has_subcategories true for a category that fits, search that category rather than a broader parent.
